entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 36, designated by siglum 𝔓36, is a copy of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the Gospel of John, it contains only John 3:14-18.31-32.34-35. The manuscript palaeographically has been assigned to the 6th century. Papyrus 36 is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
